data.gender_notes: Margarita is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A daisy or pearl. The name Margarita has Greek and Latin origins, and comes from the name Margarites, which means pearl. In Christianity, Saint Margaret is the patron saint of expectant mothers and travelers, and the name Margarita is derived from her name. The name also has connections to the Virgin Mary. The name Margarita carries the meaning “Pearl, daisy” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Margarita usually hope their child will grow to embody pearl, daisy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes purity, devotion, and the strength of the soul. Margarita is a name that brings a sense of calm and tranquility, and is believed to be a name that brings good fortune and happiness.
data.etymology: Margarita belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pearl, daisy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Margarita total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
